capabilities: Seed a vault by downloading an entire GitHub repository file by file
Pull incremental changes and push them as one atomic git commit via the GitHub REST API
Auto-sync on an interval, after idle editing, or when Obsidian opens or returns to the foreground
Merge concurrent text edits with a git-style 3-way merge and conflict markers
Skip per-device files such as plugin data, workspace state, and cache
extras: GitHub-only (no GitLab, Bitbucket, or Gitea); GitHub API caps apply (100 MB per file, ~100k files per tree, 300 files per compare). Not yet in the community plugin store; beta install is via BRAT. The Personal Access Token is stored in the plugin's data.json, which is excluded from sync.
intentEvidence: The popular obsidian-git plugin uses isomorphic-git, which loads entire packfiles into memory during clone and pull.
motivation: The author spent hours debugging why obsidian-git could not clone a vault on iOS, traced it to isomorphic-git memory exhaustion, and built this REST-based alternative in one session.
problem: Git-protocol sync plugins like obsidian-git exhaust the iOS WebView memory heap on large vaults, silently crashing Obsidian and wiping its config folder.

relations.evidence: The popular obsidian-git plugin uses isomorphic-git, which loads entire packfiles into memory during clone and pull.
BRAT lets you install plugins straight from GitHub.

requires.name: GitHub Personal Access Token with Contents read/write

summary: Two-way vault sync with a GitHub repository via the GitHub REST API, designed to work on iOS where git-protocol sync plugins crash.
